name: New Keybinds
description: Customizable gameplay bindings, instant actions and mobile Smart Controls.

jump-p1.name: Jump (Player 1)
jump-p1.description: Primary gameplay input. Multiple keys can be assigned.

jump-p2.name: Jump (Player 2)
jump-p2.description: Secondary gameplay input. Multiple keys can be assigned.

place-checkpoint.name: Place Checkpoint
place-checkpoint.description: Places a checkpoint in Practice Mode.

delete-checkpoint.name: Delete Checkpoint
delete-checkpoint.description: Deletes the latest checkpoint in Practice Mode.

editor-title.name: Editor
editor-title.description: Custom shortcuts for the level editor.

move-obj-up.name: Move Selection Up
move-obj-up.description: Moves selected objects up using the native editor command.

move-obj-left.name: Move Selection Left
move-obj-left.description: Moves selected objects left using the native editor command.

move-obj-down.name: Move Selection Down
move-obj-down.description: Moves selected objects down using the native editor command.

move-obj-right.name: Move Selection Right
move-obj-right.description: Moves selected objects right using the native editor command.

noclip-toggle.name: Noclip / Ignore Damage key
noclip-toggle.description: Forward N to the game; requires a compatible feature handler.

hitbox-toggle.name: Hitbox key
hitbox-toggle.description: Forward H to the game; requires a compatible feature handler.

trail-toggle.name: Trail key
trail-toggle.description: Forward T to the game; requires a compatible feature handler.

speedhack-toggle.name: Speedhack activation key
speedhack-toggle.description: Forward K to the game; requires a compatible feature handler.

instant-actions-title.name: Instant Actions
instant-actions-title.description: Configurable shortcut keys for common actions.

instant-gameplay.name: Open Gameplay Level
instant-gameplay.description: Jump to the configured level browser query.

instant-practice.name: Open Practice
instant-practice.description: Open the configured level browser query for practice selection.

instant-level-id.name: Target Level ID
instant-level-id.description: Level ID used by the Gameplay/Practice actions.
